chunks: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fadhl, from Marwan ibn Muslim, from some of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

I asked him, 'What do you say about a man who made the affair of his wife in her hand?' He said, 'He gave the authority to one who is not its rightful owner, and contradicted the Sunnah, and did not validate the marriage.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a husband giving his wife the power of divorce?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) rules that if a husband grants his wife the authority of *takhliq* (conferment of divorce) without proper authorization, he deviates from the Sunnah and his marriage is deemed invalid (*ghayr mujiz*). This highlights the Shia juristic view that the husband retains the primary right to divorce, and delegating it improperly undermines the structural integrity of the marital contract.
